title: Initial configuration lies in every window
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $s$ be any natural number. The initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ has every work-tape head in $[-s,s]$ and has blank contents at all work-tape cells outside that interval.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-state nondeterministic machine $N$ over binary alphabet
